scales.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight font-serif

hero.style: Full-width background image with heavy warm overlay (bg-black/40) to ensure text readability.
hero.cta: Bright primary color button, rounded-full, with hover scale effect.

cards.menu_item: Pure white background, 16px border-radius, soft shadow. Lifts on hover (translate-y-[-4px]). Include a green dot icon for veg. 'Add' button in primary red.

navigation.customer: Sticky top, white background, bottom border shadow. Logo on left, floating cart button on right.
navigation.admin: Sidebar layout on desktop, pure white sidebar, #F8F8F8 main content area. Red active state accents.
navigation.menu_tabs: Horizontal scrollable tabs on mobile. Active state uses red text and a smooth underline animation.

cart_drawer.style: Slide-in from right. White background. Sticky bottom checkout button.

admin_dashboard.style: Bento grid for stats (Active orders, revenue, etc.). White cards on grey bg.
admin_dashboard.table: Clean, borders between rows, colored status badges (e.g., green for Ready, yellow for Preparing).

kds_system.style: High legibility. Darker headers for tickets. Color-coded timers and statuses. Grid layout prioritizing current active orders.

toast.style: White background, soft shadow, colored left border indicating success/error.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Google Fonts: 'Poppins' for body text and UI components, and 'Playfair Display' for Headings.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='menu-add-button').
Do NOT use pure black; use #1A1A1A for high-contrast text.
Implement Shadcn UI components but override their default borders/radii to match the 16px (rounded-2xl) warm cafe theme.
Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs for seeding the menu item mock data.
For the KDS view, ensure order cards are large and instantly readable with clear color-coding for status (Received -> Preparing -> Ready).
For Admin dashboard, ensure the background is #F8F8F8 to contrast with the pure white cards.
Apply translate-y-[-4px] and shadow on hover for all menu item cards to give a premium feel.
